title: The Voices

lines.text: Oh, voices never speak, and all night
Now they're in the corner, out of sight
And oh, they're on the fleeting little whispers
And they're sleeping till the sun burns out
Then they're gonna scream and shout
Hold your breath and count to ten
Remember that it's all in your head
If you let them in, they'll breed and spread, and oh
Gotta take them, gotta break them
Gotta shake them, gotta make them
Even stutter till they're all burned out
